`final class NodeAnimateEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeAnimateEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeAnimateEvent.java)

The event of `onAnimate`, with the animator of a node and the value it reached on this frame.

## Description

[`Node.onAnimate`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onAnimate) fires on the frames where an animator given to [`Node.animate`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-animate) changes its value.
